title: Align: a split piece moved away, its cut face put back onto the YZ plane it was split with (it only slides across onto the plane)

expect.note: The block -40..40 x -10..50 x 0..40 split at x = 0; Body keeps x -40..0 (40 x 60 x 40 = 96000, A = 2*(2400 + 1600 + 2400)). Moved by (-60, 0, 60): x -100..-60, z 60..100. Its cut face (normal +X, centre (-60, 20, 80)) onto the YZ plane: an endless plane, so the centre only goes across to (0, 20, 80) and the body is x -40..0, z still 60..100 (Luca, beta 3.2: before, the YZ plane of the body that moves was refused, and a plane sent the centre to the plane's origin (0, 0, 0): x -40..0, y -30..30, z -20..20). Measured: the body that moved.
